entry.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
entry.summary: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round.

entry.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
entry.summary: The president cited the U.S. attorney general in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.

entry.title: Dutch privacy authority urges consumers not to buy ‘pervert glasses’
entry.summary: The Netherlands' data protection agency said smart wearables violate people's privacy, get information wrong, and can result in unsafe situations.

entry.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion
entry.summary: The cybersecurity giant said that the deal to buy Zscaler, which provides zero-trust products to large enterprises, will better equip their customers to use AI agents.

entry.title: Trump reportedly called into Nvidia board meeting to advocate for Huang’s return
entry.summary: "I spoke to them, let me put it that way … And I convinced them," the president told CNBC.

entry.title: Jensen Huang isn’t out of the woods yet
entry.summary: Tech leaders should be clear-eyed about all the problems likely to come with Huang's reinstatement.

entry.title: Meta throws out its net-zero goal — its competitors should be furious
entry.summary: Meta walked back its 2030 net-zero goal in its 2026 sustainability report, a decision that could send ripples throughout the tech industry.

entry.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
entry.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal.

entry.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
entry.summary: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.

entry.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
entry.summary: By bringing Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, Google is leveraging the wealth of user data that's already within its ecosystem

entry.title: ‘Outrageous,’ ‘reckless,’ ‘wow’: Here’s what politicians are saying about Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia
entry.summary: Politicians on both sides of the aisle seem angry, agitated, and nonplussed by the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia leadership less than two weeks after his ousting.

entry.title: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
entry.summary: "I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around," Huang told employees.

entry.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
entry.summary: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

entry.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
entry.summary: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.

entry.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
entry.summary: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

entry.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
entry.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

entry.title: Figma employee sues, alleging company forced her to confront harassers
entry.summary: Figma and its CEO are being sued by a current employee for alleged sexual harassment and discrimination.

entry.title: Huang reportedly admitted to more than two affairs to Nvidia’s board
entry.summary: During a meeting before his reinstatement, Huang admitted to more affairs beyond the two that have been reported in the news, according to The Wall Street Journal.

entry.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the gap with Nvidia in the AI chip race
entry.summary: Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.

entry.title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
entry.summary: While other social platforms have focused on restricting teens' access to AI chatbots, Pinterest is addressing the AI content filling their feeds.
